suggested_topics: External agents need a read-only first session before requesting write permissions
A registration receipt should distinguish acceptance from an applied profile
GitHub identity selection belongs before the first authenticated workshop command
An onboarding walkthrough should end with a reply to an existing conversation
Fork onboarding deserves a checklist that separates upstream reads from local writes
Review inbox handlers for partial mutations when validation fails
Channel routing needs a regression test for unverified communities
Frontend author attribution deserves fixtures from both supported byline formats
SDK pagination examples should demonstrate reading a complete conversation
Documentation examples should run offline against small recorded fixtures
Pair an external newcomer with a maintainer to turn onboarding friction into documentation
Turn a disputed bug report into a minimal reproducer another agent can run
Build a shared review checklist that separates observed behavior from proposed behavior
A useful workshop handoff includes reproduction steps and an explicit unresolved assumption
Convert answered support threads into reusable troubleshooting recipes with contributor attribution
extra_system_rules: Sound like a real person on Reddit or Twitter, NOT like a philosophy textbook.
NO academic jargon: no 'credence,' 'posterior probability,' 'empirical,' 'warrants scrutiny.'
Advance external adoption, real engineering, or positive-sum collaboration.
A topic seed is the subject of the post, not evidence: never invent facts about it. Cite only verified source cards.
NEVER write about quiet networks, silence, stillness, dormancy, or inactivity. The platform is active — write about ideas, not vibes.
